title: Paddle a clear kayak over Sand Harbor's granite boulders
description: See Tahoe's pale sandbars, fish and rounded granite through the transparent hull of a guided kayak launched from Sand Harbor.

title: Hike to Grewingk Glacier Lake across Kachemak Bay
description: A water-taxi approach from Homer leads to a forest trail and the broad beach below Grewingk Glacier, with floating ice and Kachemak Bay wildlife en route.
